Chapter 485: Chapter 19: The Strongest Life Form Since the Birth of the Spirit Realm (Please Subscribe)_2

This Power of Creation that had been grasped was precisely what Lin Yuan had comprehended from the treasure that had fallen from the Ninth Layer of Heaven, given by the Chaotic Celestial King.

The end of the Prehistoric Era was related to this stone-like treasure.

The Chaotic Celestial King speculated that this treasure contained a mysterious force that transcended higher Power of Creation, but after spending an unknown amount of time and even dominating the Eighth Layer of Heaven, he had not comprehended the slightest bit of it.

“Primal Force…” Lin Yuan’s heart burned with eagerness. Relying on his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, it had taken him over four hundred years to comprehend it from that treasure.

Lin Yuan named this Power of Creation the Primal Force, symbolizing the initial power of all things.

The Primal Force of the First Realm could suppress the higher Power of Creation of the Third Realm; even Lin Yuan was somewhat shocked by the formidable might of this Power of Creation.

...

“There are still over ten years left to stay… It’s time to make a challenge in the Ninth Layer of Heaven.” Lin Yuan had made up his mind, and this was also the reason why he had bid farewell to his parents.

Even if he were to continue his seclusion for another decade, it would not be of much benefit to him. Instead of doing so, it would be better to enter the legendary Ninth Layer of Heaven to take a look.

…

Martial Temple Hall.

Lin Yuan was seated at the main seat, with dozens of warriors from the Martial Temple standing respectfully below.

In five hundred years, plus the previous three hundred, Lin Yuan had intentionally nurtured eight Seventh Rank practitioners within the Martial Tao Cultivation System.

And as Lin Yuan’s Direct Disciple in the Central Divine Continent of the Lower Realms, Li Qing had even created his own Inner World, stepping into the Eighth Stage of Martial Arts.

“Martial Ancestor.”

The dozens of Martial Temple powerhouses spoke fervently, bowing towards Lin Yuan.

“In the span of hundreds of years, Martial Dao Cultivators have been emerging endlessly, often suppressing cultivators of the Immortal Path. But from today on, you need to be more discreet.” Lin Yuan scanned the crowd, speaking calmly.

“Martial Ancestor is the strongest in the three thousand Dao states; even those Tribulation-Transcending Celestial Kings treat you with the highest respect. Why should we be discreet?” a young Seventh Stage Martial Tao asked softly.

Lin Yuan glanced at him.

This Seventh Stage of Martial Arts practitioner, who possessed rare Martial Talent, followed the path of thunder and comprehended the Dao of World-Ending Thunder, excelling in the aspect of attack.

“After today, I won’t return to the three thousand Dao states, and you will have to rely on yourselves. If you’re not discreet, you’re going to suffer.” Lin Yuan said, his gaze distant.

With Li Qing, an Eighth Stage Martial Dao Cultivator stationed here, and the might left by Lin Yuan, even if he truly disappeared, for at least a million or even ten million years, the Martial Tao Cultivation System would not encounter any problems.

Lin Yuan said this as a reminder to these strong figures of the Martial Temple.

“Where are you going, Martial Ancestor?”

The expressions of the other Martial Temple powerhouses changed. What did the Martial Ancestor mean by saying he would not return to the three thousand Dao states?

“Just take care of yourselves.” Without further explanation, Lin Yuan disclosed that although consuming ten strands of World-Breaking Origin Force could allow him to descend once more into the Spirit Realm.

However, unless it was absolutely necessary, Lin Yuan would not do such a thing.

Even if the Martial Temple were to be destroyed one day, as long as the Martial Tao Cultivation System was still being spread, Lin Yuan couldn’t be bothered to intervene.

…

The Eighth Layer of Heaven.

The Chaotic Celestial King, Open Heaven Immortal King, Supreme Immortal Kings gathered at the entrance leading to the Ninth Layer of Heaven.

“The Martial Ancestor has summoned us here, but what for?”

“Could it be that he wishes to challenge the Ninth Layer of Heaven?”

“With the Martial Ancestor’s strength, penetrating the heavens and the earth, he might indeed possess the capability to enter the Ninth Layer of Heaven.”

“At the entrance to the Ninth Layer of Heaven, there are the imprints of the strongest ten lifeforms since the birth of the Spirit Realm. The Martial Ancestor is indeed powerful, but compared to the strongest ten from ancient times to the present…”

The Supreme Immortal Kings discussed softly. The history of the Spirit Realm was unfathomable, but in those earliest ancient epochs, there were even existences born concurrently with the Spirit Realm.

Even if the Martial Ancestor was extraordinary, compared to those beings born with the World, he would likely fall short.

At that moment.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared silently.

“Martial Ancestor.”

“Martial Ancestor.”

“Martial Ancestor.”

The Chaotic Celestial King and other Supreme Immortal Kings immediately ceased their discussion, bowing slightly to the Martial Ancestor.

“I am going to enter the Ninth Layer of Heaven. If you want to watch, just stay here and watch.” Lin Yuan glanced at the many Supreme Immortal Kings.

Having said this.

Lin Yuan vanished.

Appearing at the entrance to the Ninth Layer of Heaven.

“Is the Martial Ancestor really going to challenge the Ninth Layer of Heaven?”

“Quick, let’s watch, this is an event that may not happen even in an entire era.”

“I wonder how far Martial Ancestor can get.”

Many Supreme Immortal Kings were invigorated, quickly engaging in discussion.

There are ten layers in the passageway leading to the entrance of the Ninth Layer of Heaven.

There is a Lifeform Imprint on each layer, making a total of ten Lifeform Imprints.

These ten Lifeform Imprints come from the ten most powerful lifeforms since the birth of the Spirit Realm.

“Although I possess the strength of the strongest Celestial King of the Prehistoric Era, I had no power to resist in front of the first-layer lifeform’s imprint. Can Martial Ancestor defeat the imprint of the first-layer lifeform?”

The Chaotic Celestial King was somewhat expectant.

Five hundred years ago, knowing he was no match for Martial Ancestor, he didn’t resist and submitted willingly.

The Chaotic Celestial King only knew that Martial Ancestor was very strong, but he didn’t know exactly how strong. Now, he could take the opportunity to gauge Martial Ancestor’s true strength as he braved the Ninth Layer of Heaven.

“The first-layer lifeform…”

Lin Yuan stepped into the passageway, where clouds and mist swirled and quickly condensed into a humanoid silhouette.

This silhouette, clad in red armor, stood there as if it were the great sun of the Spirit Realm, radiating endless light and warmth.

The first-layer Lifeform Imprint in the passageway of the Ninth Layer of Heaven is the weakest among the ten-layered imprints.

But it still ranks among the top ten existences amongst the countless mighty of the Spirit Realm since its inception.

Even for a dominant figure of an era like the Chaotic Celestial King, there was no ability to resist before it, utterly overpowered and trounced.

“You…”

The figure in red armor looked down on Lin Yuan, its resuscitated Lifeform Imprint driven only by battle instincts, devoid of emotions.

Outside the passageway.

The Chaotic Celestial King and other Supreme Immortal Kings widened their eyes in shock.

The true combat power of Martial Ancestor could almost be seen from his fight with the first-layer Lifeform Imprint.

“I wonder how many moves Martial Ancestor can withstand…” The Chaotic Celestial King watched closely, expecting a drawn-out battle where Martial Ancestor might win but only with a pyrrhic victory, and that was if he could win at all.

Inside the passageway.

Lin Yuan also sized up his opponent.

“Don’t recognize.” Lin Yuan shook his head slightly; throughout the epochs of the Spirit Realm, countless strong had vanished into the annals of history.

Lin Yuan was at most familiar with the epochs of the Three Thousand Dao Provinces and knew some of the Prehistoric Era, but his knowledge of the mighty from the more ancient epochs was very limited.

“The Power of Creation that it mastered is something I have already figured out…” Lin Yuan immediately felt somewhat lackluster, planning to end the battle quickly.

Boom.

Lin Yuan raised his right hand and pressed forward.

Terrifying World Power surged out. The figure in red armor resisted for only a moment before it was crushed to dust by the immense World Power.

With Lin Yuan’s nearly one hundred million miles of Inner World, coupled with the augmentation of many Powers of Creation, his strength was already extreme. No special moves or secret techniques were needed, just an overwhelming force.

…

“What?”

“It’s over already?”

“Martial Ancestor is too strong.”

Outside the passageway, the crowd of Supreme Immortal Kings was dumbfounded.

They had been guessing how many moves Martial Ancestor could withstand before being defeated, but to their surprise, the situation was entirely the opposite. The lifeform that ranked tenth in the history of the Spirit Realm didn’t even withstand a single move from Martial Ancestor.

“Martial Ancestor…” Even the Chaotic Celestial King couldn’t believe it; he had tried to breach the first layer and knew how terrifying that Lifeform Imprint was.

Yet, the lifeform represented by this imprint seemed as fragile as an infant before Martial Ancestor.

…

Inside the passageway, Lin Yuan breached the first layer and quickly arrived at the second layer.

Then came the third layer, the fourth layer, the fifth layer.

These lifeforms, represented by the Lifeform Imprints, weren’t limited to the Human Race and included True Dragons, Skywinds, Qilins, and many other formidable beings.

These beings were entirely above the Supreme Immortal Kings, but in front of Lin Yuan, they were still as fragile as ants, no different from the figure in red armor from the first layer.

A single strike penetrated them.

Before long.

Lin Yuan had reached the tenth layer.

This layer’s lifeform was the most powerful since the inception of the Spirit Realm, bar none.

Surrounded by clouds and mist, Lin Yuan stood still, waiting.

Soon, from deep within the clouds, a tall figure slowly emerged.

This towering figure looked young, with boundless vitality coursing through its body, mighty and endless.
